title: Large Bear in Zoo Enclosure Behind Fence, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white snapshot capturing a large dark bear standing within an enclosure made of heavy pipes and chain-link fencing, typical of mid-20th-century municipal zoos or roadside wildlife attractions. The reverse side bears a stamped processing code 'W941', several handwritten pencil marks, and child-like vertical lines.
